D31 — 2026-10-05
chose: Score round 4 after each rep. Hold files park r2 and r3 behind each previous rep; when a rep's three arms finish, run score-batch, check-rep and round4_claims.py on the reps so far, then release the next rep. No product change happens between reps: rc.5 stays the pin for all of round 4. After any rep the operator may stop round 4 early for futility, fix, and re-test in a new round on a new held-out chain. That is logged as a deviation before the stop. A futility stop cannot raise a false win, but changing the product mid-round would break rep comparability and the freeze (D30).
over: Scoring only after rep 3 (results wait ~2 days), or fixing sofar between reps and continuing round 4 on a new build (mixed versions; the frozen claims would no longer mean anything)
because: Operator 2026-10-05: "It is always better to score after each rep… If rep 1 is already failing we can try and fix it and then start rep 2." Per-rep scoring is a hold plus scoring (not a deviation, PRE-REGISTRATION-R4 §9), and it allows an early futility stop that saves allowance. A mid-round fix is the one part that cannot stay inside round 4.
